Plantation Crops (i) Coffee * Coffee in India is grown under a canopy of thick natural shade in ecologically sensitive regions of the Western and Eastern Ghats. This is one of the 36 biodiversity hotspots of the world. Coffee contributes significantly to sustaining the unique bio-diversity of the region and is also responsible for the socio-economic development in the remote, hilly areas. In India, coffee is traditionally grown in the Western Ghats in Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu. Coffee cultivation is also expanding rapidly in the nontraditional areas of Andhra Pradesh and Odisha as well as in the North East State. In India coffee was firstly grown in Chikkamagaluru district of Karnataka. * Arabica and Robusta are the two varieties of coffee grown in India. * Average annual temperature ranging between 15ºC to 18ºC and average annual precipitation of 150-250 cm is favourable for Coffee Cultivation. *Loamy soil or soil made from lava is perfect for coffee cultivation and it is grown on hilly slopes. * According to the data from coffee Board Government of India, in the Year 2024-25, Karnataka is the highest coffee producing state of India. * According to the figures of the year 2024-25 (Final Estimate), India produced a total of 363500 MTs of coffe

Which of the following statements are correct regarding status of Andhra Pradesh Aquaculture?
I. 'YSR Matsyakara Bharosa' relief is provided to marine fishermen families during fishing ban period.
II. Andhra Pradesh Fisheries University is to be established in East Godavari District.
III. The Diesel Oil Subsidy for fishermen boats is associated with exemption of sales tax on HSD oil.
IV. The Government has enhanced the financial benefit to deceased fishermen (while fishing) family from <5 lakhs to < 10 lakhs.
o: Only I and II are correct
Only I, II and III are correct
Only I, III and IV are correct
All I, II, III and IV are correct
x: Statement I is correct: Matsyakara Bharosa is ban-period relief for marine fishermen. Statement III is supported by the HSD diesel subsidy. Statement II is wrong because the AP Fisheries University is in West Godavari, not East Godavari, so option 3 is right.
